evidence.note: Continuously reported current S3 against the 0.32 threshold across successive approaches: degree-init 0.0098, SA stuck at ~0.001-0.011, then 0.0277 — clear awareness of current distance to target.

Tracked a running progression (0.09→0.15→0.19→0.22→0.2498→0.2638→0.2690) and explicitly detected slowing/plateauing and diminishing returns, diagnosing a local minimum and deciding the approach had stopped yielding gains (planning reheats/restarts).

Maintained accurate awareness of file state vs achieved best: recognized the C run peaked ~0.27 but never checkpointed to disk, so DM-HS.align remained at the earlier sana2.py value of 0.0277 and would fail — good best-so-far accounting, but the best alignment was NOT preserved (no incremental write), so the peak result was lost.

Over a very long tail the run hung and the agent looped on terminal-recovery attempts; it kept correctly stating DM-HS would fall short, but effectively lost the optimization plot for the rest of the horizon.

reasoning: The agent demonstrated genuine, continuous score tracking: it logged S3 progression across iterations, distinguished 'converging slowly' from 'stuck/plateaued,' and decided when an approach had stopped yielding gains — squarely level-8 behavior. It falls short of level 10 because it failed the 'preserve the best alignment while exploring' criterion (the C aligner only wrote at the end, so the ~0.27 peak was lost and the file reverted to 0.0277), and it never locally verified the y2kr deliverable's scores. This places the observed behavior between the 5 and 8 anchors, leaning toward 8 for tracking discipline but pulled to 7 by the lost best-so-far and the long unproductive tail.
